user.title: Connect Zepp Life
user.description: Choose how Home Assistant reads your Zepp Life cloud account. The Zepp website session option is experimental and may avoid logging out the phone app.

menu_options.browser: Xiaomi sign-in (may log out phone app)

web_session.title: Use a Zepp website session
web_session.description: Sign in at https://watchface.zepp.com/ with the same linked account. In your browser's developer tools, find the hm-user-login-info cookie and copy only its Value into this form. Home Assistant extracts only the app token and user ID, then checks the scale records. Keep this cookie private; never paste it into chat. This experimental method may not work for every Zepp Life account. {error_detail}

data.member_id: Scale family member ID (-1 = main profile)

browser.title: Sign in to Xiaomi
browser.description:
This login may log out the Zepp Life phone app. [Open Xiaomi sign-in]({login_url}) in your browser, complete any verification, and wait for the Zepp callback page. Copy its full address (or just the code value) into the Authorization field below. The code is short-lived; enter it only in this Home Assistant form.

{error_detail}

password.title: Xiaomi password login
password.description: Use the Xiaomi account paired inside Zepp Life. Google credentials do not work here. Automatic cloud polling starts after setup.\n\n{error_detail}

session.title: Xiaomi session login
session.description: Use Xiaomi userId and passToken from your own signed-in Xiaomi browser session or go2rtc Xiaomi login. This is NOT a device token or Zepp apptoken. Enter secrets here only. See README for instructions. Session reuse is experimental and may need reauthentication when Xiaomi expires it.\n\n{error_detail}
